title: Cream of Cauliflower & Cheese Soup
ingredients: 500 mL (2 cups) light cream or milk
250 mL (1 cup) grated Alberta Old Cheddar
directions: Cut cauliflower into flowerettes. Boil in 500 mL (2 cups) water till soft. Drain, reserving liquid.

Melt butter, add onion, simmer until soft. Blend in flour then add chicken broth, stirring over medium heat till creamy. Stir in 250 mL (1 cup) cauliflower liquid, milk or cream, seasonings. Add cauliflower and bring to boil, stirring constantly. Remove from heat, stir in cheddar. Sprinkle with freshly chopped parsley.
(If smooth consistency desired whip in blender or food processor). Serves: 6.

title: Basil & Zucchini Soup
directions: Heat butter & oil in medium sauce pan. Add onion & garlic stir over med heat 2 min. or microwave high for 3 min. or until onion is soft.
Stir in zucchini, water, stock cubes, sugar & juice. Bring to boil, reduce heat, simmer uncovered - 20 min. or microwave high - 20 min., or until zucchini is tender.
Stir in basil. Blend or process mixture in several batches until smooth, return mixture to pan & reheat.
Serve topped with sour cream, paprika & extra basil leaves. Serves 4
notes: Soup can be made a day ahead, keep covered in fridge. Recipe can be frozen for 2 months.
WINNER APRIL 1 - Herb Starter Kit And Blue Flame Cookbook - LILY BURAK, Calgary
raw_text:
Basil & Zucchini Soup
Soup can be made a day ahead, keep covered in fridge.
Recipe can be frozen for 2 months.
15 g butter                        3 cups water
1 T oil                            2 small chicken stock cubes, crushed
1 med onion chopped                2 t sugar
2 cloves garlic, crushed           1 T Lemon juice
6 med zucchini, finely chopped     1/3 c chopped fresh basil
Heat butter & oil in medium sauce pan. Add onion & garlic stir over med heat 2 min. or microwave high for 3 min. or until onion is soft. Stir in zucchini, water, stock cubes, sugar & juice. Bring to boil, reduce heat, simmer uncovered - 20 min. or microwave high - 20 min., or until zucchini is tender. Stir in basil. Blend or process mixture in several batches until smooth, return mixture to pan & reheat. Serve topped with sour cream, paprika & extra basil leaves. Serves 4

title: Minestrone Soup (veg)
directions: Soak beans overnight in cold H2O. Trim fat from ham & render it in skillet. Drain beans & put in stock with ham bone.
Brown garlic & onion in the fat. Add other vegies until they are just wilted. Add all boiling bean mixture, salt & pepper to taste & simmer tightly covered for 1 1/2 hrs.
Add vermicelli & tomato paste & cook another 1/2 hr. If soup too thick add more stock or H2O.
Parmesan cheese can be sprinkled on top.

title: Turkey Noodle Soup
ingredients: 750 g (1 1/2 lb) Alberta turkey wings, tips removed
1 tomato, skinned & chopped or 150 mL (2/3 cup) canned
25 mL (2 tbsp) chopped fresh parsley (10 mL/2 tsp dried)
directions: Place turkey wings in a large saucepan and cover with water; add bay leaves and quartered onion.
Cover and bring to boil
Cook 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until wings are tender. Remove wings and strain broth.
Return broth to saucepan and add remaining ingredients.
Bring to boil, cover and cook about 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Meanwhile, remove turkey from bones and discard skin and bones.
Return meat to broth and cook 4 to 5 minutes or until hot.
